title.en: An Act Reappropriating Certain Sums Appropriated in Republic Act Numbered Sixteen Hundred Thirteen

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3301_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
The sums appropriated in Priorities Numbered 50, 52, 60 and 61, page 58-B, group II, for the Province of Leyte, appendix B of Republic Act Numbered Sixteen hundred thirteen, to wit:
"50 Bato Katipunan Construction ₱2,000.00 "52 Bato Tabunoc Construction 2,000.00 "60 Bato Mabini Construction 2,000.00 "61 Bato Naga Construction 2,000.00 totalling eight thousand pesos, are hereby reappropriated, for the construction and/or improvement of the Central School in the Municipality of Bato, Province of Leyte.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1961.
